effect_description_eng:
While you have an [Appmon] trait Digimon or Tamer on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] By trashing 1 [Appmon] card from your hand, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When Digimon are deleted, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・You may link 1 [Appmon] Digimon card from your trash to 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
